description.value: Once per round, when you throw a Graft you may throw a second prepared Graft of Mk I or Mk II as part of the same action, at the same target or a different one. Roll each separately. A creature caught by both takes splash from the higher-Mk Graft only — the second one is already spent by the time it lands.

cinderfall.incomplete: No combo rule element resolves two independent consumable applications (throwing a second prepared Graft) as one activity, same reasoning as Both Hands, Both Patients.
